Texas Senate Nominee James Talarico Returns to Campaign Trail After Absence

Texas Senate nominee James Talarico has returned to his campaign trail following a multi-day absence. The absence had drawn scrutiny, with reports indicating he was suffering from the flu. Talarico has now reappeared and resumed his campaign activities.
